description: Part-load COP with driving heat temperature effect and crystallization limit

unit.name: Generic 500kW Single-Effect LiBr-H2O Absorption Chiller
unit.source: Herold, Radermacher & Klein (2016); Gordon & Ng (2000); ASHRAE Handbook (2020) Ch.2

plr_curve.note: COP_PL/COP_ref = f1 + f2*PLR + f3*PLR^2. COP improves slightly at part-load until PLR~0.3

temp_curve.note: COP correction for driving heat temperature: f_Thot = g1 + g2*(T_hot - T_hot_rated)

g2.note: COP improves 0.5% per K above rated T_hot

PLR_min.note: Below 0.15, crystallization risk in LiBr solution
